services.desc: CruiseRI is a showcase for all of Conanicut Marine Service Inc.’s charter boats, which includes Coastal Queen, the Jamestown Newport Ferry fleet and launch boats. Let us know what you have in mind for your event and we can make it happen! CruiseRI offers a versatile fleet of vessels accommodating 34 to 140 passengers, with convenient docking locations in Jamestown and Newport, Rhode Island. Whether you’re planning an intimate gathering or a large celebration, our fleet is ready to float your party.Private charters are available mid-February through December 31, with vessel availability varying by date. blurb: Guests can enjoy narrated scenic cruises around Newport Harbor and Narragansett Bay, including lighthouse tours and sunset sails. The Coastal Queen offers themed event cruises, private charters for groups from 34 to 140 passengers, and packages combining cruises with helicopter tours. Cruises feature amenities like heated interiors, onboard bars, and catering options.
extraNote: Reservations recommended, especially for event cruises which sell out · Deposit required for luxury cruises · 1 East Ferry Wharf in Jamestown for event cruises · Evening scenic cruises generally operate May 1 to September 30
